title: Bullets of Fury - Official Trailer
author: MikesWorldNYC
selftext:
Bullets of Fury, your ultimate Shmup is coming soon!

While no official link is avaliable yet, I am hosting private beta testing over at the ColeForge Discord as this is being aimed for a Steam release. 

9 pilots - Each with their own special temporary 15 second ability boosts they acquire in-game. 

8 levels (1 bonus additional level as well)

18 Bosses/Mini-Bosses

1 Hell of a Campaign!

I've spent about the last 4 months working very heavily on this game. Through trial and error I created my own engine and dev tools alongside using Claude to help develop this. Sounds were created through a custom sfx engine I developed based on Yamaha chips.

Music - Suno produced, human riff created. I've been a guitarist and performer IRL for over 20+ years. 

To follow the project and more upcoming productions, join the discord: https://discord.gg/3syTEAA3c

Hope you all enjoy and looking forward to the pre-orders when I launch the steam page next week!
